Off-catalogue: 0.0% of dots within 300 m of a mapped fault, median 2,062 m. Unique against 475 harvested registry comparators: max |tie-aware Spearman| 0.0128, worst symmetric 3-px-dilated Jaccard 0.0918 (GEMSDOE42__docs_downloads_gems42-xscale-worm-persistence-20261006T000541Z-nan.tif), 0 comparators over the 0.70 overlap limit among the non-vacuous; 14 comparators are flagged vacuous because their own 3-px dilation covers >=70% of the footprint (IR-62-22). Method: four Lahontan levels detected from the DEM (1455/1389/1325/1278 m), a robust tile-mode isobase per level, steps flagged in the physical 15-140 m throw window, and a Hough vote requiring the flagged pixels of >=2 distinct levels on one common line. The lateral-deflection leg of the lane is a measured NULL at a 1.2 km lever arm (IR-62-DEFL-01).
